title: Peter Schiff on the Bitcoin Crash: “Get the Hell Out”
summary: ▶ Bitcoin Magazine Peter Schiff on the Bitcoin Crash: “Get the Hell Out” Challenged on why two or three down years would matter for Bitcoin when gold and the Nasdaq have had similar streaks before recoveries, Peter Schiff says the difference is the backdrop. This post Peter Schiff on the Bitcoin Crash: “Get the Hell Out” first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Patrick Green .
